name: Chris Rothfuss
stance: Supports state rules requiring human review of consequential AI decisions and opposed the federal moratorium.

statements.text: I'm relieved to see at least one deeply problematic provision removed from an otherwise deeply flawed bill.
Backed a draft bill in the Select Committee on Blockchain, Financial Technology and Digital Innovation Technology barring AI from making consequential government decisions without human approval.

review.note: research pass, September 2026; not yet reviewed
